param: flat route (one knob, 60-frame stride, full undistort chain, 32-bit)
hypothesis: the lights-built sky flat and/or GraXpert Division attenuate frame-filling extended structure; the arm preserving NAN contrast while correcting the field wins
verdict: WIN A32 - own per-set 32f sky flat preserves the most extended structure of the corrected arms; GraXpert AI Division absorbs ~2/3 of it (dead-ends entry); no-flat unusable (multiplicative falloff has no in-doctrine downstream fix). Real flats at acquisition remain the true fix; GraXpert classical-grid interpolation untested.

param: stack-chain intermediate bit depth (one knob: set16bits+savetif vs set32bits+savetif32+dt bpp=32)
hypothesis: 16-bit integer intermediates quantize away faint per-frame signal (step 1 ADU vs extended contrast ~1-4 ADU) and can degenerate robust statistics (measured MAD=0 on the full set-03 stack)
verdict: WIN A32 - the 16-bit chain reads only ~55-70% of the 32-bit arm's extended contrast on identical frames+flat; retirement is a signal fix, not only the MAD/autostretch repair. Declared delta for the set32bits change (commit 38c2946).
